result.journal: EURASIP Journal on Wireless Communications and Networking
result.keywords: AbstractIn wireless sensor and intelligent IoT environments, localization accuracy and robustness against adversarial disturbances are both critical. This paper proposes a hybrid method that combines range-free positioning with 5G-assisted edge defense for networked perception systems. First, a multi-radius DV-Hop style estimator is used to reduce hop-count error in uneven node deployments. Then, a lightweight singular-value-based denoising module is applied to suppress adversarial perturbations in traffic sign and sensor image streams before coordinate inference. The method uses cosine-theorem correction, trilateration, and maximum-likelihood refinement to improve unknown-node localization while maintaining low latency under MEC-supported processing. Experiments on synthetic wireless sensor networks and traffic sign benchmarks show improved positioning accuracy, stronger resistance to adversarial attacks, and lower average error than baseline schemes.

result.title: An improved 5G-assisted location defense algorithm for wireless sensor and traffic sign IoT systems
